resource.title: Manufacturing process of Sakuramil drug substance (IROHA-corp.)
resource.description: Four-step synthesis CP-4 -> CP-5 (in situ) -> CP-6 -> CP-7 -> CP-9 (Sakuramil). Typical commercial batch size 350 kg.

action.title: Step 1
action.description: CP-4 is combined with methyl chloroformate, lithium-tert-butoxide, and tetrahydrofuran, then stirred. Layers are settled and separated. Precipitates are filtered, rinsed with tetrahydrofuran and dried to yield CP-5.

action.title: Step 2
action.description: CP-5 is combined with sodium borohydride, magnesium chloride, and methanol, then filtered after the reaction completes. Hydrochloric acid is added to the filtrate, layers are settled and separated. Organic layer is distilled with ethanol, and the mixture is stirred with water. Resulting precipitate is filtered, rinsed and dried to yield CP-6.

valueCodeableConcept.text: CPP #3.1 Water addition in the crystallization (% by weight with respect to ethanol)

action.title: Step 3
action.description: CP-6 is combined with tetrahydrofuran, sodium carbonate, and ethyl chloroformate, then heated to reflux. Upon reaction completion, the mixture is filtered and quenched with sodium hydroxide, n-hexane is added, the layers are separated, and the organic layer is distilled with ethanol and stirred with water (CPP #3.1). After filtering and drying it results in CP-7.

action.title: CPP #3.1 Water addition in the crystallization (% by weight with respect to ethanol)

extension.valueString: 98-105 L; then 20 to 35% w/w of ethanol

valueCodeableConcept.text: CPP #4.1 Water addition in the crystallization (% by weight with respect to ethanol)

action.title: Step 4
action.description: CP-7 and CP-8 are combined in methylene chloride followed by the addition of tetra-n-butylammonium bromide and aqueous sodium hydroxide solution while mixing. Upon reaction completion, methylene chloride and water are added (CPP #4.1); ethanol content is monitored by IPC #1. The mixture is separated, washed, cooled (CPP #4.2, IPC #2) and concentrated with ethanol. After filtering and drying it results in CP-9 (Sakuramil).
